```yaml
name: Release Scrapers

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  build-and-release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install OCaml toolchain
        uses: ocaml/setup-ocaml@v2
        with:
          ocaml-compiler: 5.2.0

      - name: Install runtime libraries
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y libev4 libonig5

      - name: Build scraper binary
        run: |
          dune build bin/scrape.exe
          echo "Binary built at _build/default/bin/scrape.exe"

      - name: Install GitHub CLI
        run: |
          sudo apt-get install -y gh

      - name: Create or update release
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          gh release create scraper-latest "Pre-built scraper binary" \
            --prerelease --repo ${{ github.repository }} || true

      - name: Upload scraper binary to release
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          gh release upload scraper-latest _build/default/bin/scrape.exe \
            --clobber --repo ${{ github.repository }}
```
